reviews.title: One Smooth U Posture Boost
reviews.review_text: This would be a nicer bra if it had a different type of fastener rather than the hooks/eyes that are difficult to work with, especially if someone has any type of hand or wrist problems. Also, why is it that so many front hook bras are made with the posture feature? Manufacturers seem to think anyone who needs a front hook bra has posture issues, when in reality it's often shoulder, wrist and/or hand issues.

I like front closure bras, but this bra is hard to work with and hook closed or open. I runs small in width .I usually wear a 38C, got a 40C in this Bali bra. The cup size was perfect. The straps are not adjustable, but these straps fit me very well. Got the only color available. Pretty good support. 179
The only times the underwires weren't digging in was when I was standing. The back was nice and smooth but I won't buy again.
too small order bigger like 2 to 3 sizes bigger feels comfy looks cheap due to no adjustments availability very difficulty to close front closer hook n eyes.

reviews.title: Getting the right size is key, and not easy
reviews.review_text: I hesitated on getting this because I saw reviews that said it ran small and I needed the largest size. I gave it a shot because it was on sale. If you get the right size, it is actually pretty comfortable. Unfortunately, getting the right size is a trial and error deal. I normally wear 44D and that one was so big it was neither supportive or attractive--it really gapped at the sides. Also, I ordered the special offer of 3 bras and then was mysteriously informed that only black was available and they canceled the beige. It worked out, since the black didn't fit and I would have been stuck with 3 bad bras, but if they had fit I would have been unhappy that I was able to order something that I was told a week later wasn't really available. I tried again, going down to a 42D and that was better (and available in beige). Still a little bit prone to sticking out on the sides--the cups aren't quite cut to fit right at the very outside and the underwire doesn't pull them in enough. Maybe if you're not overweight, getting all of those hooks together in the front is easier, but I find it a little challenging, and sometimes they pop open (not all, but the top one or two will pop depending on what I'm doing). Overall it's more comfortable than a sports bra (that just squishes everything, this is an real bra), and the straps don't dig like a traditional bra. I can't honestly say if it's doing anything for my posture, but I think it is a bit smoother all around than my traditional bras.

reviews.title: One little issue...
reviews.review_text: Really comfortable, good support, especially in back, but the underwire popped through one side after one week of wear. I'm going to try sewing over the little hole it came out of, and see if it stays put. I was considering buying another one, as I liked it so much, but I will hold off until I see how well the repair works.
